AI Integration in Higher Education Discussed at South Asia Policy Dialogue

A policy dialogue focused on the integration of Artificial Intelligence in higher education took place in South Asia. The event, referred to as the 2026 Leadership Policy Dialogue and AI Leadership Summit 2026, involved discussions on responsible and innovative AI implementation. MAXHUB and KLH Global Business School were noted participants in these discussions.
